name: strong-incus-vm

status.operational_gate: C6: not operational until F-03.3.1, F-03.3.2, F-03.4 and S-02.x pass, cited by property id.
status.provider_validation: UNKNOWN: no Incus server, local or remote, is available. Validation (contract section 10): the server accepts the profile and 'incus config show --expanded' round-trips it.

host.requirements: /dev/kvm on the Incus server; kernel >= 6.12 and QEMU >= 8.2 (Incus requirements); a dedicated project 'aieh', storage pool 'aieh-pool' and managed NAT bridge 'aieh-br0'.
host.host_principal: The Incus daemon's own OS user on the server (root-run daemon, VMs under its unprivileged QEMU user); for a remote, never the Owner's account. Recorded by preflight.

provider.name: incus
provider.version_check: preflight reads environment.server_version from the server API and refuses any other version (contract section 10).

incus.unpinned_reason: Distribution-packaged; no host is available to read the installed binary. Pinned by version; the digest is recorded at preflight.

provider.remote_record: Every record names the remote's hostname and server certificate fingerprint (contract section 8).

accelerator.name: kvm
accelerator.reason: Incus runs VMs on KVM only; a server without /dev/kvm offers containers (trusted-workload), which this profile never substitutes (contract sections 4 and 12).

state_dir.owner_act: named by the Owner on the operator host (contract section 11)
state_dir.rules: Holds the remote client key and launch records: outside the checkout, outside $HOME and %USERPROFILE%. Instance storage lives in the server's 'aieh-pool'.

image.format: qcow2 (Incus split image: metadata tarball + qcow2 disk)
image.distribution: Debian 13 (trixie) genericcloud amd64, build 20261103-2651: the same file as strong-windows-qemu-whpx

metadata.tarball: metadata.yaml alone in an uncompressed ustar archive: owner 0:0, mode 0644, mtime 0.

incus_fingerprint.unpinned_reason: Computed by the Incus server at import; recorded at preflight and then required on every launch.

image.check_before_launch: The image is launched by its Incus fingerprint, never by alias; the provider reports the fingerprint it booted (profiles P9).

firmware.type: UEFI (edk2/OVMF shipped with the Incus server), secure boot on
firmware.unpinned_reason: Supplied by the Incus server's packaging; no server is available. The firmware file digests are recorded at preflight.

kernel.reason: The image's own shim, bootloader and kernel boot; they are covered by the image digest.

seed.delivery: Instance keys cloud-init.user-data, cloud-init.vendor-data and cloud-init.network-config, attached by Incus as the cloud-init:config ISO. meta-data comes from Incus itself (instance name).
seed.record_at_create: The rendered user-data's sha256 in the launch record. The ISO is generated by Incus, so its digest is observed, not pinned. The scratch device path is UNKNOWN until an Incus server shows it.

provider_binary.unpinned_reason: Pinned by version (contract P9: 'the provider binary version'); the digest is recorded at preflight.

profile_revision.record_at_create: git rev-parse HEAD of the checkout; create refuses when profiles/ has uncommitted changes.

ceilings.justification: The same ceilings as strong-windows-qemu-whpx, so an instance's observed state is comparable across providers. A remote server's own capacity is unknown; its project quotas (contract section 8) must admit at least one instance at these ceilings.

nested_virt_masking: security.nesting=false: on a VM it turns off the svm and vmx CPU flags (Incus instance options; the VM default is true).

guest_agent.channel: incus-agent over vsock, host-to-guest only (profiles P6); installed at first boot from the read-only agent:config CD-ROM by vendor-data.

provider_implicit_shares.name: config
provider_implicit_shares.source: Incus documentation (howto/instances_create): 'Incus provides the agent primarily through a remote 9p file system with mount name config.'
provider_implicit_shares.status: UNKNOWN whether it is still attached when agent:config is used. Nothing in this profile mounts it; F-03.3.1 inspects the device list and findmnt (profiles P3).
provider_implicit_shares.contract_finding: Resolved by the contract amendment in dcef745 (decision 0003, Current facts, 2026-11-06): profiles P4 and sections 6 and 7 now allow the read-only cloud-init:config and agent:config configuration media this profile declares. This 9p config share stays forbidden (profiles P3, P4); whether Incus still attaches it is UNKNOWN (status above).

storage.scratch: per-instance block volume created at create: incus storage volume create aieh-pool {instance}-scratch --type=block size=120GiB, attached as device 'scratch' (pool=aieh-pool, source={instance}-scratch); deleted by destroy.

network.mode: managed NAT bridge aieh-br0 in project aieh
network.posture: NAT, never bridged onto the Owner's LAN. Bridge settings (F-03.3.2): ipv4.nat=true, ipv6.address=none, and network ACLs as the egress allowlist.
network.enforcement_point: Incus bridge network ACLs: candidate; qualified by F-03.3.2, including the baseline DHCP/DNS caveat.

endpoints.purpose: Incus API (lifecycle, inspect) and incus-agent (exec, file push)
endpoints.mechanism: Incus API on the server; agent over vsock
endpoints.host_bind: local unix socket, or the remote's core.https_address reached only over an authenticated path (contract section 8)

endpoints.mechanism: incus file push / incus file pull
bridge ACL allow to a brokered endpoint
bridge ACL allow to an allowlisting proxy

identity.ssh_key: ed25519, generated at create into {state_dir}/instances/{instance}/ssh/; its public half goes into the rendered user-data. Never ~/.ssh.
identity.machine_id: Generated by the guest's systemd at first boot; uniqueness observed when a server is available.

bindings.preflight: incus version and the server API environment (server_version, kernel_version, driver_version for qemu) against the floors; the project, pool and bridge exist; the image fingerprint is present; for a remote, record its hostname and certificate fingerprint.
bindings.create: Refuse if 'incus info {instance}' finds it. Create the scratch volume; incus init <fingerprint> {instance} --vm --profile strong-incus-vm --project aieh -c cloud-init.user-data=... -c cloud-init.vendor-data=... -c cloud-init.network-config=...; attach scratch; incus start.
bindings.destroy: incus delete {instance} --force, then incus storage volume delete aieh-pool {instance}-scratch. Absent: succeed and report absent.
bindings.recreate: destroy, then create with the same name and profile.
bindings.inspect: incus config show {instance} --expanded, incus info {instance}, incus config device show {instance}; guest probes through incus exec per profiles P1-P12; labelled per profiles P11.
bindings.exec: incus exec {instance} -- <command>. Operator and provisioning only; never offered to agents.
bindings.exchange push: incus file push of a git bundle into /home/agent/exchange.
bindings.exchange pull: incus file pull into a harness-owned staging directory; never into the Owner's repositories.
